tts_text: Great educators change lives... yet too many coaching institutes spend half their day wrestling with disconnected spreadsheets, manual fee registers, and fragmented parent updates.
Meet Pratham One Edu O-S — the unified operating system engineered specifically for modern coaching academies. Enterprise power, with the everyday simplicity of WhatsApp.
From the moment you log in, your entire institute comes into focus. Live revenue collections, daily student attendance, and batch capacity — updated in real time across every branch.

Search any student record in under a second, backed by one canonical profile identity and role-based privacy locks. And at the fee counter, automated installment schedules, U-P-I Q-R tracking, and instant digital receipts eliminate reconciliation errors.
Empower your faculty with EduBoard for interactive digital teaching, alongside one-tap Q-R attendance terminals that trigger instant WhatsApp alerts to parents.
When admissions, fees, academics, and parent communication speak one language, administrative overhead drops — freeing your team to focus purely on student results.

Your institute's data belongs to you. Deploy Pratham One Edu O-S on your own on-premises campus servers for complete institutional custody — or choose our cloud and hybrid architecture for multi-branch scale.

Built for real-world campus conditions: local L-A-N operations keep front-desk billing and attendance running smoothly on your local network, syncing seamlessly whenever internet connectivity is active.
Run your institute with clarity and confidence. Pratham One Edu O-S — Coaching Management. Simplified.
